title: Vintage Ronson Leona Table Lighter Hand Painted Floral Ceramic Newark NJ USA
descriptionText:
Vintage Ronson "Leona" table lighter, made in Newark, New Jersey, USA - a mid-century (1940s-50s) desk lighter with a cream ceramic body hand-painted with orange flowers and green leaves, on an ornate embossed gold-tone metal pedestal base with a matching cap and snuffer arm. Stands about 3.5 inches tall, base about 2.5 inches across.

Bottom is marked RONSON (R) NEWARK N.J. U.S.A. / U.S. PATENT RE NO 19023 / CANADA PATS 289140-289833 and RONSON "LEONA", with the two original screw-in fuel and flint plugs in place.

Condition: Shows honest age wear - chipping and flaking to the cream paint around the shoulder and back of the body (most noticeable on the back side, see photos), and the gold-tone finish on the base and cap is worn and darkened. The lighter arm moves and the mechanism is intact, but it has not been tested - it will need flint and fluid. Sold as-is as pictured; please review all photos, they are of the actual item you will receive.
